requests.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: one production anchor for a native-pixel Clockwork game UI sprite, not a screenshot or moodboard. Reference image 1 is an unchanged game background for material/palette only; reference image 2 is the existing game world palette only. Create a single isolated rectangular UI element on actual transparent alpha, front-on orthographic, entire frame visible with generous transparent margin. Crisp carefully placed pixel-art clusters, restrained 16-bit industrial mechanical style, deep navy charcoal, cool gray steel, tiny cyan and muted brass accents. Thin stepped/chamfered pixel corners, quiet matte dark center for small text. The center must be uniform enough for nine-slice reuse; all decoration confined to outer frame/corners. No characters, no environment, no cast shadow, no glow, no gradient, no text, no letters/numbers/logos, no extra elements or sheet, no floating labels. Design is understated and compact so gameplay stays central; avoid ornamental gears and bulky ornament. Primary request: ONE wide information-panel frame, approximately 3:1 aspect. Its thin steel contour is mostly low-contrast, with a small cyan inset in one corner and tiny brass rivets. It will be sampled to approximately 96x32 native pixels, then nine-sliced as slim HUD cards, a one-line help toast and restrained menus. Preserve usable clean edges and corners; a subtle border is more important than decoration.
